title: Add Postcard Worlds to games
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Postcard Worlds](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-postcard-worlds) to games
- Type a place and an AI paints it as a postcard. A vision model finds the doors, paths and windows in the picture; click one to step into the next view, painted to match the last using the previous vie

Fixes #15742, fixes #15728

gist.headline: Wish you were here, again
gist.blurb: Type a place, get a painted postcard, then click a door or path to wander into the next one. Postcard Worlds makes sightseeing a pleasantly recursive activity.
gist.summary: Postcard Worlds joins the games list: it paints a place entered by the player, uses a vision model to find clickable doors, paths, and windows, and paints each next view to match the previous one.
gist.impact: Players get a postcard-sized world to explore by stepping through details in each AI-painted scene.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Postcard Worlds game as a stack of painted postcards, with a little doorway in the front postcard opening onto the next matching landscape. Polli, wearing a tiny travel scarf, steps toward the doorway; flowers and a lime-green garden path connect the scenes.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art scene shows painted postcards propped in a flower garden, their tiny doors and windows opening onto connected landscapes; a bold lime green (#ecf874) path leads from one postcard to the next. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, wearing a tiny travel scarf and stepping through a postcard doorway. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites, and subtle CRT glow.
